主要内容: On September 14, 2015, The Walt Disney Company entered into a terms agreement with Goldman, Sachs & Co. and J.P. Morgan Securities LLC, as representatives of the underwriters, regarding the offer and sale of $500,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 1.500% Notes Due 2018, $750,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 2.150% Notes Due 2020, and $750,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 3.150% Notes Due 2025. The notes were registered under the Securities Act of 1933 and issued under a Senior Debt Securities Indenture dated September 24, 2001. The 2018 Notes were offered at 99.915% of par, with net proceeds of 99.715% after underwriting discounts of 0.200%. The 2020 Notes were offered at 99.750% of par, with net proceeds of 99.400% after underwriting discounts of 0.350%. The 2025 Notes were offered at 99.762% of par, with net proceeds of 99.312% after underwriting discounts of 0.450%. The document was signed on September 16, 2015, by Roger J. Patterson, Associate General Counsel of The Walt Disney Company.
